data.description: May the Holy Light protect us on our expedition to the frozen north.
data.name: Muradin Bronzebeard's Silver Coin

data.description: I really wish you mages would get your heads out from inside your own... books.
data.name: Aegwynn's Silver Coin

data.description: May my sisters realize their full potential, the name Windrunner known as a result of their deeds.
data.name: Alleria's Silver Coin

data.description: Grant me the strength to accept the things that I cannot change, the courage to change the things I can, and the wisdom to know the difference.
data.name: Antonidas' Silver Coin

data.description: Oh, why won't you notice me? Abbendis, I would follow you anywhere. I wish you would notice me...
data.name: Arcanist Doan's Silver Coin

data.description: I pray that when the time comes, I will have the strength to thwart the forces beyond the gate.
data.name: Fandral Staghelm's Silver Coin

data.description: How does this fountain even work? I wonder if I could make one.
data.name: High Tinker Mekkatorque's Silver Coin

data.description: Turalyon and Alleria, wherever you are, may you be well.
data.name: Khadgar's Silver Coin

data.description: May my son Arthas always act in the best interest of his people.
data.name: King Terenas Menethil's Silver Coin

data.description: Where's Illidan?
data.name: Maiev Shadowsong's Silver Coin

data.description: <You sense the ringing of three tones in your head, the third barely audible under the others' din.>
data.name: Medivh's Silver Coin

data.description: I hope that my father and brothers outlive me. I'll not make much of a king.
data.name: Prince Magni Bronzebeard's Silver Coin

data.description: I wish I would grow up, it feels like I've been 10 for years.
data.name: Anduin Wrynn's Gold Coin

data.description: Young Arthas must learn patience to temper his power. I will pray that he one day learns how to lead with care rather than force.
data.name: Uther Lightbringer's Gold Coin

data.description: Already, I've a kingdom in my prospects, a land to rule. What to ask for? Perhaps a frozen scone...
data.name: Arthas' Gold Coin

data.description: I wish someday to retire to my own tidy little estate, with a bunch of pet dogs to keep me company.
data.name: Arugal's Gold Coin

data.description: Brann Bronzebeard was here.
data.name: Brann Bronzebeard's Gold Coin

data.description: Sometimes... I wish someone would come along and just give me a big, long hug.
data.name: Kel'Thuzad's Gold Coin

data.description: Arthas, my love, please come back to me.
data.name: Lady Jaina Proudmoore's Gold Coin

data.description: Listen, little wishing fountain. You'll give me all your power if you know what's good for you.
data.name: Lady Katrana Prestor's Gold Coin

data.description: I hope my sisters and I can grow up and get married together. This coin appears to be very old.
data.name: Sylvanas Windrunner's Gold Coin

data.description: It is my wish that my dear Taelan will grow strong enough to defend the people he cares for.
data.name: Tirion Fordring's Gold Coin

data.description: I wish to know how you survived my wrath, little fountain.
data.name: Archimonde's Gold Coin

data.description: Explain my dreams, little fountain. Why must I always be viewing my kin from above and moving them like pawns?
data.name: Valdrus Blackthorne's Gold Coin

data.description: It seems my moonlighting days as a postal worker are coming to an end.
data.name: Umbrinoth's Gold Coin

data.description: Grom, may you rest well, old friend.
data.name: Thrall's Gold Coin

data.description: This doesn't make sense. Why am I putting a coin in a fountain?
data.name: Sonya Darkhallow's Gold Coin

data.description: The amount of coins shining in the pool. Maybe no one will notice if I take just one.
data.name: Zarla Ober's Gold Coin

data.description: Wish I had that cousin of mine's duty to do nothing more than lug wood around carelessly...
data.name: A Footman's Copper Coin

data.description: I wish Captain Sanders would hurry up with my shipment of wine.
data.name: Vargoth's Copper Coin

data.description: I wish for happiness and acceptance for my daughter. She feels so out of place here...
data.name: Ansirem's Copper Coin

data.description: Can I have a more comfortable saddle? My hindquarters ache.
data.name: Attumen's Copper Coin

data.description: I hope a troll dies, right... NOW.
data.name: Danath's Copper Coin

data.description: Being a rogue is hard work. Someday I hope to pursue my life's one true passion...
data.name: Elling Trias' Copper Coin

data.description: I hope I end up in another book eventually.
data.name: Falstad Wildhammer's Copper Coin

data.description: I wish I had my father back...
data.name: Inigo's Copper Coin

data.description: I wish I'd kept that coin...
data.name: Landro Longshot's Copper Coin

data.description: I wish people would stop knocking my toys off the shelf.
data.name: Squire Rowan's Copper Coin

data.description: I could have used this copper for something productive. Perhaps something with string and a machine.
data.name: Rath'mael's Copper Coin

data.description: It's not even magical here.
data.name: Mason's Copper Coin

data.description: How does a tavern run out of ale!
data.name: Ofalo's Copper Coin

data.description: I miss my sword and shield. I feel so naked without my sword and shield.
data.name: Sair's Copper Coin

data.description: Here you go, Nozdormu. What was I supposed to do after this?
data.name: Rhonin's Gold Coin

data.description: How do I prove they copied us with this fountain?
data.name: Elaadrin Evengale's Silver Coin
